**Prerequisite:** none — Day 1 assumes no prior R

## Capstone project

An individual analysis demonstrating the full arc:

- import and clean a survey dataset
- produce at least one weighted estimate
- one publication-quality table and one chart
- a model **or** a map
- delivered as a rendered Quarto report

## Materials provided

Workshop data pack (PDHS, PSLM, MICS), Pakistan shapefiles, all scripts in this
repository, the prompt libraries in `days/05-ai-workflows/`, and a certificate of
completion.
